description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointment by President Hon.W.S.N.W.B.M.S. Kumari Arambepola state Minister of Health has Resigned from office as the state Minister w.e.f.13.09.2024 and Appointed Hon.W.S.N.W.B.M.S. Kumari Arambepola minister of Parliament as the state Minister of Health Women and Child Affairs w.e.f.13.09.2024.
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively announces the resignation and subsequent appointment of a named individual (Honourable Wijayapala Sri Narayana Wasala Bandaranayake Mohottalalage Seetha Kumari Arambepola) to a government position (State Minister). It provides only the basic title of the position ("State Minister of Health, Women and Child Affairs") without detailing the specific portfolio responsibilities or duties. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2), which covers government personnel changes without detailed portfolio descriptions.
